ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota's Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails and connections between different fraud schemes in Minnesota

ideas.title: The Role of Government Officials in Minnesota's Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: Examine the involvement and responses of government officials, including Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison

ideas.title: The Human Impact: Stories from Minnesota's Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: Share personal stories and experiences of those affected by the fraud schemes, including victims and community members

ideas.description: Investigate potential international connections and collaborations in the fraud schemes, including ties to Somali communities
